question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 65 π cm² and the radius of its base is 5 cm, What is 40% of the volume of the cone, in cm³?
solution:
**Given:**

The curved surface area of a cone = 65π cm²

Radius of the base = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

Volume of cone = 1/3 πr²h

l² = r² + h²

**Calculation:

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bea99c4cc43a4d1bdc8363f413f5efe3e0182c93a6bc3f0a72df8abaf620cd0.png] 

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

⇒ π × 5 × l = 65π cm²

⇒ l = 13 cm2 

 l² = r2 + h²

⇒ (13)² = (5)² + h²

⇒ 169 = 25 + h²

⇒ h² = (169 – 25) = 144

⇒ h = 12 cm

Volume of cone = 40% of (1/3 πr2h)

⇒40/100 × [1/3 × π × (5)² × 12] cm³

⇒40/100 × (1/3 × π × 25 × 12) cm³

⇒ (40/100 × 100π) cm³

⇒ 40π cm³

**∴ The volume of cone is 40π **
